title: Import cards
wordsHint: Enter one word per line, or separate them with commas. You will get a draft of meanings and examples. Please leave out personal details such as student names.
textHint: Paste vocabulary-book text as it is. Numbers, words, meanings and example lines can be mixed. Please leave out personal details such as student names.
textPlaceholder:
1. apple 사과
I ate an apple.
2. run (v) 달리다
notice: This is an AI draft. Please check it against your textbook.
duplicates: Left out because they already exist or repeat:
addHint: Rows reach the editor only when you press Add. Saving the set is a separate step there.
noInput: Enter some words or vocabulary text.
wordTooLong: Words can be up to 80 characters. Check the long lines.
textTooLong: Vocabulary text can be up to 8,000 characters. Please split it up.
nothingFound: No cards could be found in that text. Please check it.
fillMissing: Fill in or remove rows with an empty front or back.
aiOff: AI drafts are unavailable right now. Enter cards by hand or try again later. Your input is still here.
aiBudget: The AI usage limit has been reached. Please try again later. Your input is still here.
aiTimeout: The AI is taking too long. Please try again. Your input is still here.
aiBusy: A draft for the same input is already running. Wait a moment and try again.
aiFailed: The draft could not be created. Please try again. Your input is still here.
photoHint: Choose or take a photo of a vocabulary page or a textbook word list. Words, meanings and examples in the photo become a draft. Up to 5 photos at a time.
photoPrivacy: Photos are only used to read the text and are not stored. Keep student faces and names out of the shot.
photoLimit: You can choose up to 5 photos at a time.
photoType: Choose image files only (JPG, PNG, HEIC).
photoDecode: This photo could not be opened. Convert it to JPG or PNG and choose it again. HEIC opens only in some browsers.
passageHint: Paste an English passage to get key words for the level with meanings. Examples are the sentences from the passage. Tick only the words you want to keep.
passagePlaceholder: Last summer, Mina visited a small village by the sea. She helped the farmers harvest potatoes…
passageTooLong: Passages can be up to 8,000 characters. Please split it up.
topicHint: Choose a topic, level and number of cards to get a draft word set.
noTopic: Write a topic of up to 100 characters.
tableHint: Paste cells copied from a spreadsheet, or import a CSV, TSV or Excel (.xlsx) file. Column order: front, back, example (optional), accepted answers (optional, separated by |). Excel files use the first sheet; a first row titled word, meaning, example, accepted answers is matched by name. Up to 200 cards.
fileError: Choose a CSV or TSV file of 250KB or less, or an Excel (.xlsx) file of 5MB or less.
xlsxError: The Excel file could not be read. Make sure it is saved as .xlsx; old .xls files are not supported.
mergeHint: Append the cards of another of your sets after this one. The other set stays as it is. Cards whose front already exists are left out.
mergeEmpty: You have no other set to merge.
mergeNothing: Nothing new to append: every word is already here.
mergeFailed: The set could not be loaded. Please try again.
noneKept: Tick at least one card to keep.
conceptHint: Make cards for science, social studies, Korean or maths terms, or Chinese characters. A unit name is enough; paste textbook text to pick terms only from it. The back is an easy meaning, or the reading for hanja.
subject: Subject

conceptUnitPlaceholder.hanja: Nature (山, 川, 日…), school life…

conceptTextPlaceholder: Paste textbook or worksheet text to choose terms only from it. Leave it empty to use the unit or topic.
noConcept: Enter a unit or topic, or textbook text.
conceptTooLong: Units can be 100 characters and textbook text 8,000 characters at most.
